# Fixed structural layout:

source_col = 1
answer_col = 2

    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().replace("\xa0", "") == "")

last_data_row = start_row - 1

        last_data_row = r

# Fill down from the closest non-blank above in column A.
last_seen = None

    src_val = ws.cell(r, source_col).value if r <= ws.max_row else None

    if r <= last_data_row:
        if not is_blank(src_val):
            last_seen = src_val
        out_val = last_seen

        if isinstance(out_val, str):
            out_val = out_val.strip().replace("\xa0", " ")
        ws.cell(r, answer_col).value = out_val
    else:
        # No source data row here; leave answer blank.

wb.save(output_path)

last_seen = None
all_match = True
for r in range(start_row, end_answer_row + 1):
    src_val = orig_ws.cell(r, source_col).value if r <= orig_ws.max_row else None

    if r <= last_data_row:
        if not is_blank(src_val):
            last_seen = src_val
        expected = last_seen
        if isinstance(expected, str):
            expected = expected.strip().replace("\xa0", " ")
    else:
        expected = None

    actual = verify_ws.cell(r, answer_col).value

    )
